subject: Suncrest pilot: finalize readout schedule & decision path
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + outline for pilot success criteria

Emily / Devon — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to get the pilot scoped and scheduled.

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood reduces average inference tail latency and predicts 30–40% lower per-token cost vs current setup for diagnostic summarization pipeline.
- Key success metrics you called out: 99th percentile latency < 300ms for 512-token requests, end-to-end throughput of 30 req/s, and model answer fidelity (ROUGE/Large prompt set) no worse than 2% vs baseline.
- Security: Suncrest needs SOC2 evidence, VPC option during pilot, and KMS support — Monica will own evidence collection.

Proposed pilot plan (high level):
1) Success criteria doc (attached) — owners + pass/fail thresholds (we'll finalize this week).
2) Data & access: secure sample payloads + range of sequence lengths (Suncrest to provide).
3) Pilot timeframe: 4 weeks active testing (2 weeks tuning + 2 weeks evaluation).
4) Readout: 60-minute exec review in week following evaluation to confirm go/no-go and next contract step.

Immediate asks:
- Emily: confirm the success criteria listed in the attached workbook and add any missing metrics by EOD Friday (10/15).
- Devon: please loop procurement on the timeline if you want pre-approved terms; include contact email.

Attachments: Suncrest_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow with a versioned POC plan once we have your feedback.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + outline for pilot success criteria

Thanks Sergio — good notes. Quick responses:
- Success criteria: the sheet looks good overall. A couple additions: add median latency target (we care about p50 as an operator metric) and an SLA-style uptime threshold (99.5%). I made comments on rows 10 and 12 in the workbook.
- Data: we'll upload anonymized sample payloads to the Drive link you send; are there any size limits?
- Procurement: looping them in now (procurement@suncresthealth.com). They prefer a short SOW + PO model; a draft SOW would help speed review.

I can confirm internal exec availability for a readout week of Nov 1–5 (PST). Devon, please confirm if that window works for you and procurement.

Emily Park
Senior Product Manager, Suncrest Health
epark@suncresthealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-15T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood POC plan v2 + scheduling options (attached)

Emily / Devon — attaching an updated pilot plan (redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf) and a brief SOW stub to accelerate procurement review. Key updates:
- Pilot weeks: target Oct 25–Nov 21 (4 weeks active testing + padding) so readout can land first week of Nov.
- Owners: Monica will own compliance evidence collection; I’ll own benchmark runs and metric reporting.
- Telemetry: we’ll export token-level latency histograms + aggregated throughput per minute.
- Fallbacks: plan includes automatic routing to a lower-cost model variant if we detect performance regressions.

Action items for this week:
- Emily: confirm success criteria comments resolved (I merged your two items into the workbook).
- Devon / Procurement: can you confirm whether a draft SOW + PO is sufficient, or do you need a signed master services agreement first?

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v2.pdf, draft_SOW_suncrest_20271020.pdf

— Sergio
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC plan v2 + scheduling options (attached)

Couple clarifications from the compliance and telemetry side: 
- Evidence checklist: I’ll pull SOC2 artefacts and a short notes pack (controls mapping) — target to deliver by 10/22.
- Telemetry ownership: suggest we define a single metric owner at Suncrest (someone to reconcile definitions). Emily, can you nominate a telemetry owner?
- Data handling: request for a short ingress checklist: accepted formats, sample size, and secure upload instructions. I’ll attach the checklist to the Drive link once I have confirmation.

Small ask for the pilot plan: add a fail-fast gate at the end of week 2 (if p99 latency > 500ms and throughput < 10 req/s) so both sides can decide to pivot early. That gating helps keep exec time efficient.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC plan v2 + scheduling options (attached)

Sergio / Monica — thanks. Procurement confirms draft SOW + PO is sufficient to start; they requested an estimate of total pilot cost so they can route the PO internally. Can you provide a one-line cost estimate and whether any refundable deposit is required?

Also — for the exec readout week Nov 1–5, Suncrest prefers Nov 3 or Nov 4 (PST). Can Redwood accommodate a 45–60 min slot on Nov 3 at 10:00 AM PT? If we present results and a recommended next step (annual committed capacity), procurement will use that readout to route approvals.

Best,
Devon
Devon Lee
Director, Platform Engineering, Suncrest Health
devon.lee@suncresthealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Devon Lee <devon.lee@suncresthealth.com>, Emily Park <epark@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC plan v2 + scheduling options (attached)

Devon — thanks. Answers and confirmation below: 
- Cost: pilot estimate = $12,000 (includes reserved pilot capacity, telemetry export, and two days of onsite tuning support). No refundable deposit required; we can start on a PO that references the draft SOW and invoice on pilot kickoff.
- Exec readout: Nov 3, 10:00 AM PT works — I’ve penciled Marissa (VP Sales) for the executive slot and will lead the demo/results. Please consider this the confirmed readout; I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (1 pager) by end of day Monday.
- Next contract step: if Suncrest signs the PO within five business days after readout, we can guarantee start of dedicated onboarding (Dedicated capacity) within 3 weeks of PO acceptance. Draft SOW link: https://redwood.app/docusign/abcde12345

Next actions: 
1) I’ll upload the finalized success criteria workbook (incorporating Emily’s notes) to the Drive and share.
2) Monica will deliver SOC2 artefacts by 10/22.
3) Procurement: please review the attached draft SOW and confirm PO routing timing.

Thanks — looking forward to the readout.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
